title: Leave figures on Leave reports
description: Leave reports now opens on the year at a glance, above the printable documents, from the same figures the documents print.
items: Days taken, regular leave allocated, remaining and used, people who took leave, pending requests
Days taken by month and by leave type
By department, and who took the most
Maternity, paternity and other life-event leave are left out of the allocation figures, so they do not bury the percentage
